octocrux-output-20261021.txt
=============================

Source: the OctoCRUX Output tab, copied verbatim by the owner (Daniel Azevedo)
on 2026-10-21 around 00:46-00:53, T480s, sysvd77 (CRUX 3.8 derivative).

Build: OctoCRUX main at 44ed952 (before the AuthenticationError and
rejected-alert changes, so the "[octoCRUX] Operation ..." summary lines and
the repeated alerts show the old behaviour).

Helper: qt-sudo 2.4.1 with the sudo backend (qt-sudo -d), sudo 1.9.17p2
(version from the 2026-10-19 capture, OPEN_QUESTIONS 2.9). The NOPASSWD sudoers
rule had been commented out by the owner, so sudo asked for a password.

Sequence, as performed by the owner:
  1. Unlock criu: password entered -> success.
  2. Lock criu: qt-sudo password dialog cancelled -> qt-sudo shows
     "Falha no processo dependente sudo! sudo: a password is required",
     owner pressed OK -> helper exit code 1.
  3. Lock criu: two wrong passwords, then the right one -> success.
  4. Unlock criu: password entered -> success.

The lines "Password: ", "sudo: a password is required" and "Sorry, try
again." are sudo's own stderr, passed through by qt-sudo. Everything else is
OctoCRUX's own output. Verified afterwards: /var/lib/pkg/prt-get.locker
(changed 00:53:20) lists only llvm clang lld compiler-rt, i.e. criu unlocked.
